topic: Claude Code v2.1.139 agent view and /goal

sources.title: GitHub release v2.1.139
key_points: Added agent view as Research Preview, opened with `claude agents`.
Added `/goal` command to set a completion condition and keep Claude working across turns.
Release also includes plugin details, hook args, continueOnBlock, MCP env alignment, and subagent telemetry headers.

sources.title: Claude Code changelog
key_points: Agent view and `/goal` are the first two listed changes.
Release frames agent view as a single list of every Claude Code session: running, blocked on user, or done.

sources.title: Manage multiple agents with agent view
key_points: Agent view dispatches and manages many Claude Code sessions from one screen.
It shows running, needs-input, idle, completed, failed, and stopped states.
Background sessions can run without a terminal attached through a supervisor process.
Every background session starts in the working directory but is blocked from writing there until moved into an isolated git worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` when edits are needed.
Agent view is a research preview and requires Claude Code v2.1.139 or later.

sources.title: Keep Claude working toward a goal
key_points: `/goal` sets a completion condition and keeps Claude working across turns until the condition is met.
After each turn, a small fast model checks whether the condition holds.
It works interactively, in non-interactive `-p`, and through Remote Control.
The evaluator does not run commands or read files independently; it judges from what Claude surfaced in the conversation.
Goal conditions can be up to 4,000 characters and should state measurable end state, check, and constraints.

sources.title: Run agents in parallel
key_points: Claude Code docs position subagents, agent view, agent teams, and worktrees as different forms of parallel work.
This supports reading v2.1.139 as a scheduling and orchestration release rather than a UI-only release.
